description:
FILED s543m (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-24), found by member 6's probes (#5351).  PRE-EXISTING: base 9fc6583b the same.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 | ./runpcl; scratch/s543m/p6/qr.pl):
    use v5.24;
    my $s = "b"; my $r = \"b"; my $q = qr/$s/; my $q2 = qr/$$r/; my $q3 = qr/b/; print "$q $q2 $q3\n";
  perl  (?^u:b) (?^u:b) (?^u:b)        PCL  (?^:b) (?^:b) (?^:b)

WHAT IT IS (suspect, not measured): under the `unicode_strings` feature (a `use v5.12`+ bundle) perl compiles a pattern with the /u charset and the qr stringification shows it; PCL's qr stringification does not add `u` from the feature (the site's unicode_strings is known: #2092's pseudo-feature for string evals, `_unicode_strings_here` for case mods).  Any code that compares or prints a qr// under `use v5.12`+ (Test::More `is($re, ...)`, a hash key built from a qr) reads a different string.  Measure: `use feature 'unicode_strings'` alone, `use utf8` alone, a /u /a /l flag written explicitly, `qr/b/u`.

=== DONE (s543m, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-24; taken after the USER's ORDINARY-or-RARE ruling) ===
MEASURED FIRST (perl 5.40.3, scratch/s543m/p9/q.pl, 14 rows): `use v5.12` / `use v5.24` / `use feature 'unicode_strings'` -> qr/b/ is (?^u:b) (qr/$s/x (?^ux:b)); no bundle, or `no feature 'unicode_strings'` -> (?^:b); an explicit /a /aa /l /u /d wins ((?^a:b) (?^l:b), /d prints no letter) -- PCL was right there; a qr interpolated into another carries its own ((?^u:a(?^u:b)), (?^ui:a(?^u:b)c)); `use utf8` alone gives no letter; a hash key of a qr is its string.  MATCHING: with the feature PCL and perl agree; WITHOUT it a /d site's /i over chars 128-255 differs (perl does not fold "\xc9" vs /\xe9/i, PCL does) -- not-supported's "Regex classes are NOT regime-dependent yet" (#2092), not this task.
THE FIX (the one place a qr's flags are written at compile time): ExprToCL::_regex_literal_form adds `u` to a qr's :flags when no charset letter is written or defaulted by `use re` and the site's _unicode_strings_here answers (the one regime reader; a string eval inherits the site's).  m// and s/// keep their flags.
PROBES: 14 rows: base 8, tree 13 (the 14th is the /d matching row above).
GUARD: Pl/t/regex-interp-01.t qr_u_bundle / qr_u_nested / qr_u_explicit / qr_u_feature / qr_u_off.  Commit d6b84d2f (WIP 10).
frequency_reason: a qr// printed or compared as a string under `use v5.12` or later (first pass from the subject, the reviewing session 2026-11-24)
subject: SILENT WRONG: a qr// under `use v5.24` (unicode_strings) stringifies without the /u flag -- "(?^:b)" where perl prints "(?^u:b)"
triage_reason: a silent wrong in qr stringification under a v5.12+ bundle: IN
